fact: Togo's revenue office announced that the pilot phase of the interconnection of the Ghana and Togo customs IT systems would start on 1 August 2023 on the Noepe/Akanu axis, with transit declarations generated in Sydonia World.
title: Communiqué de l'Office Togolais des Recettes relatif à la phase pilote de l'interconnexion des systèmes informatiques douaniers du Ghana et du Togo
